phenomenon: Marienhöhe illuminated during the blue hour on Norderney
colour_harmony_note: The original deep-blue evening sky and warm amber lighting naturally harmonise with DTL deep teal and amber; the photograph has not been recoloured or tinted.
caption: Warm lights from Marienhöhe sit against the blue hour on Norderney, one of Germany's East Frisian Islands.
